_comment: Per-clip locomotion metadata. blend_in_seconds = inertialization decay duration when this clip becomes loco_current. translation_source: 'velocity' (clip-cadence-must-match-walk_speed/run_speed) or 'root_motion' (clip drives world translation directly via consumedHipDelta). All directional gait clips use root_motion so world speed always matches authored foot cadence — no foot-skate, no per-clip walk_speed tuning. Idles stay on velocity (default) since they're stationary anyway.

clips._comment: One-shot. Authored hip XZ travel is ~0.7m -- below the 1.5m default extraction threshold -- so it must declare root_motion explicitly or PoseSampler leaves the motion in the pose (mesh visibly travels, sPlayer.pos doesn't, slide-snap at clip end).
clips.name: getting_up_3

clips._comment: Wolf clips (Quaternius rig). All in-place authoring: the animator built feet-cycling-while-body-stationary clips and leaves world translation to the engine. velocity lets walk drive via tun.walk_speed * dt; attack uses in_place so the bite's 0.586m authored hip step stays visual (no slide). gallop / gallop_jump removed -- Lupa is walk-only per the 'tired legend' framing in wolf.json; re-add entries here when a future archetype actually uses them.
clips.name: walk

clips._comment: Lupa's pre-engage idle: looped chew on the Lonza carcass. In-place so the chew motion doesn't translate the actor (the carcass is fixed at her feet via static_meshes).
